blockers.summary: Admission is not fail-atomic; a pin-overflow exception can leave partially mutated scheduler state.
Coherent UMA lacks per-object serialization, complete directory invariants and checked version increments.
ACK/credit completion uses the wrong frozen event priority, and synthetic alignment valid ranges are not enforced.
Topology permits duplicate link/bridge IDs and does not enforce half-duplex reverse-pair group closure.
Phase 5 action membership and ExpertKey-to-object identity are caller-labelled rather than semantically validated.

claim_boundary: CPU-synthetic TRACE_COMPILED_NON_ADAPTIVE two-domain direct-P2P and object-granular coherent-UMA scheduler evidence only; FUNCTIONAL_ONLY or ANALYTIC_FIRST_ORDER and RANGE_UNKNOWN.
authorized_next_stage: Phase 6 CPU-only remediation and a fresh immutable same-hash candidate/review only.
